review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T001. The evidence decision (L2 CONSTRAINT, author-approved) lives in docs/standard; this contract records inputs, model, observation chain and gaps. Timing, propagation and detector modelling are inherited from the published analysis, not reproduced.

question: Which interval of the UET non-minimal coupling xi_c is excluded by published binary-pulsar DEF bounds, and in which scalar-mass domain does that exclusion apply?

output.quantity: excluded xi_c interval (light-scalar domain bound on m_psi reported separately in eV)
output.domain: beta0 in [-4.8, -4.0] analysed by ZFKSW22; neutron stars 1.25-2.0 Msun; m_psi c^2 <= hbar c/(10 a_max)
output.accuracy: Interval endpoints are exact maps of the published prior range through beta0 = -2 xi_c; no statistical re-analysis.

model.assumptions: Ordinary matter couples minimally to the Jordan metric; psi0 = 0 background (alpha0 = 0); the massless-scalar DEF analysis applies when the scalar Compton wavelength exceeds 10 times the widest orbit.
model.approximation: Exact Jordan-to-Einstein map; Newtonian Kepler separation with GR masses for the domain bound only.
model.initial_boundary: Asymptotic scalar value psi0 = 0; isolated binaries as analysed upstream.
model.parameters: xi_c and m_psi free; no fitting; registered data used exactly as transcribed.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Published constraint with exposure SEEN_SUMMARY under Test Card T001 (CONSTRAINT, not a blind prediction).

system_partition.boundary: Seven published pulsar binaries (neutron star plus white-dwarf or neutron-star companion) observed by radio timing; the comparison uses the published DEF posterior bound, not raw timing data.

systems.state: Joint description of each binary, not an extra state

state_accounting.rule: Orbit energy and scalar dipole loss are counted once in the published post-Keplerian model.

systems.state: Neutron-star matter and effective scalar coupling alpha_A

state_accounting.rule: alpha_A is the published effective coupling; not recomputed here.

systems.state: Companion star matter and its effective coupling
Radio telescope timing record and published fit

state_accounting.rule: Observer record only; carries no source energy.

couplings.map: Gravitational and scalar interaction in the binary (published DEF dynamics)
Radio pulses through the interstellar medium; dispersion and Shapiro delay modelled upstream
Times of arrival fitted upstream to post-Keplerian parameters
Radio reception exerts no admitted backaction on the neutron star
No admitted backaction on the companion

observables.backaction_scope_reason: Both binary owners are assessed; the binary aggregate is a nonadditive view. Passive radio reception is not admitted as feedback.
observables.quantity: Published |alpha_A| upper limit over the beta0 prior range, and orbital periods and masses
observables.readout_map: Published combined Bayesian analysis (ZFKSW22); transcribed values only

observation.source_state: Neutron-star and companion states as modelled by the published analysis.
observation.generated_trace: Pulse arrival times; not a UET trace variable.
observation.carrier: Radio pulses (photons); not identified with any UET field.
observation.observer_state: Telescope timing record and published fit.
observation.readout: Published post-Keplerian parameters and DEF bound.
observation.backaction: None admitted from passive radio reception.
observation.frame: Solar-system barycentric frame of the published timing solutions

components.reason: Binary systems, masses and DEF coupling as registered from the published tables and bound.
No external drive beyond the published isolated binaries.
Applied upstream in the published timing analysis (ZFKSW22); not recomputed here.
Galactic acceleration and proper-motion corrections to Pb_dot. Applied upstream in the published timing analysis (ZFKSW22); not recomputed here.
Timing fit and Bayesian DEF bound. Applied upstream in the published timing analysis (ZFKSW22); not recomputed here.
Map of the published beta0 range through beta0 = -2 xi_c and Kepler separation for the domain bound.
Closed-form arithmetic; Kepler and mapping functions covered by physics tests.

error_budget.approximation: Massless-scalar DEF bound applied only inside the declared light-scalar domain.
error_budget.measurement: Inherited from the published 90% CL analysis; not re-derived.
error_budget.systematic: EOS dependence handled upstream over 13 EOSs; journal-version cross-check of transcribed values not done.
error_budget.omissions: xi_c outside [2.0, 2.4] and heavier scalars are not constrained by this contract.
error_budget.dependence: Single published analysis; no independent combination.
error_budget.acceptance: Constraint report only (Standard v2 T001); no physical acceptance claim in this contract.

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T001 constraint calculation only. Evidence level is set in docs/standard (L2 CONSTRAINT). Not a prediction and not a falsification test while xi_c is free.
next_action: Cross-check transcribed values against the journal version; extend to beta0 < -4.8 only with an additional registered source.
